stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 20 m by 10 m is surrounded by a path 3 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $26$ m by $16$ m, an area of $416$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $200$ square m leaves $216$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
